name: Warriors: Golden Leaf
source:
Warriors: Golden Leaf is a visual novel/dating simulator based on the Warriors book series by Erin Hunter. The main love interest in this game is Mapleshade.

[From [url=https://captaingaykid.itch.io/warriors-golden-leaf]Itch.io[/url]]
